Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 但是城市有才两个学校：这个城市，只有

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，古代 already expresses a time period, so adding 的时候 is redundant.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 城市有才两个学校：城市里才有两个学校，才 must come before the verb 有 to show that the number is limited; 里 marks the city as the location.
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子：一个叫孟子的男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国，at first mention, introduce the character with his name and a full noun phrase instead of naming him only in the following sentence.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 所以孟子老是祭拜：所以他老是祭拜，after a close mention with no competing male character, use a pronoun.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子不是祭拜：他不是祭拜，after the immediately preceding reference to the same character, use a pronoun rather than repeating the name.
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他很喜欢他的城市：他很喜欢自己的城市，when the possessor is the same person as the subject, 自己的 makes that relationship clear.

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 的时候 is redundant here.
有才 is incorrect, but the required limited-quantity form is 只有 rather than 才有.
The main character should be identified by name at the first mention.
After the immediately preceding mention of 孟子, 他 is the appropriate close reference.
The pronoun change is correct, but the displayed text cuts off the 不是……就是…… structure.
自己的 clearly marks the city as belonging to the subject 他.
